messages:
vivian: Quick sync: launch social plan for May webinar. Need final X thread, 2 LinkedIn posts, 1 hero GIF + static, LP with UTMs, and SDR routing rules by tomorrow 5pm PT. Can we divide?
sam: Ill write the X thread and two single-tweet versions. Will tag variants [dev] and [enterprise]. Need GIFs and final LP URL to finish UTMs. Target noon.
arthur: Design will output GIF (animated metric chart) and a static JPG. Uploading 1MB GIF for X and 1200x675 MP4 for LinkedIn. ETA 4pm.
vivian: Also want 2 headline tones: explicit numbers and benefit-forward. Sam can you prep both so we can A/B on scheduler?
sam: Yep. Drafting: (A) "2-3x lower inference latency on real workloads" (B) "Ship faster, serve cheaper: inference optimized for production." Tagging legal for benchmark wording.
legal: Please attach benchmark spreadsheet and prompt details. We need the workload definition to approve numeric claims. 48h turnaround after complete docs.
arthur: Assets prep: uploaded to /design-assets/may-webinar. Files: hero_chart_1mb.gif, hero_static_1200x675.jpg. Alt text added: "Animated chart showing latency drop and cost savings."
design-bot: Reminder: include PNG fallback for LinkedIn and <1MB GIF for X to avoid upload failures.
sdr-team: Routing rules draft: company_size>150 -> enterprise_queue; 20-150 -> sdr_rotation; <20 -> nurture. Also set watch_time>50% -> priority flag and tag. Will sync mapping to SFDC fields once webhook path posted.
vivian: Devops, can you create LP webhook path and put secret in vault so we can wire Zapier? Need path + env var name.
devops: Created /hooks/webinar-signups and env var WEB_SIGNUP_SECRET in vault. Doc: https://internal.devops/webhooks#webinar.
sam: Added UTMs to copy doc: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=may_webinar&utm_content=variantA. Also included alt text and suggested first reply with recording CTA.
arthur: Compressed GIF is 980KB, PNG fallback 280KB. MP4 for LinkedIn is 1.2MB.
vivian: Checklist before 5pm tomorrow: 1) copy in scheduler, 2) assets in design-assets, 3) LP live + UTMs, 4) webhook + secret, 5) SDR routing doc. React with :white_check_mark: when complete.
sam:  (will finish copy by noon)
arthur:  assets uploaded + alt text added
sdr-team:  routing doc posted to SDR drive and linked in scheduler
legal: I'll review the benchmark files once folder is complete. Please ensure baseline and test harness links are included.
vivian: Thanks all. I'll run the scheduler tomorrow morning and post final times here. If any blocker, flag in this thread. :thumbsup:
